hardware.tested_state: get_signing_status diagnostics added to scaffold protocol

procedure: Added the shared get_signing_status request/response contract in NostrSeal/specs.
Updated ESP32 host-core and smoke tooling to answer get_signing_status and include it in get_capabilities.
Ran NostrSeal/esp32 make ci with 38 Python tests, host-core tests, and firmware validation.
Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for build, flash, and smoke.
Verified idf.py and esptool.py paths and confirmed idf.py --version reported ESP-IDF v5.5.4.
Built clean app version 7ca2548 with make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-flash.
Flashed bootloader, app, and partition table to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 and verified image hashes.
expected_result: The firmware exposes deterministic signing-readiness diagnostics while preserving the disabled signing protocol contract.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built app version 7ca2548 with binary size 0x8a7f0 and 0x75810 bytes free in the app partition. esptool detected ESP32-S3 QFN56 revision v0.2 with native USB-Serial/JTAG and MAC ec:da:3b:95:32:98, wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images, and verified hashes. The smoke passed with 35 verified exchanges: 8 valid response frames and 27 expected rejection frames. get_signing_status returned signing_enabled false with all runtime signing-readiness gates missing, and sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: Protocol smoke only; no production key custody, trusted display acceptance, physical approval acceptance, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, or real signing acceptance was tested.
get_signing_status is diagnostic only and does not authorize signing.
get_public_key still uses the deterministic development fixture key.

sign_event is expected to remain signing_disabled until parser limits, trusted display review, physical approval, provisioning, storage, signed-output verification, and firmware hardening gates are complete.
